description: Cooler Master CMP 320 ARGB M-ATX Mini Tower Casing Cooler Master CMP 320 ARGB M-ATX Mini Tower Casing ensures a compact solution for gamers to feel style and performance in one go. Equipped with two pre-installed 120mm ARGB fans and a mesh Geode front panel, it will ensure the best airflow for cooling efficiency. It sports a sleek black exterior with a tempered glass side panel to showcase components and a full PSU shroud to give a neat look. Measuring 445.5 x 204 x 425mm (including protrusions) and boasting a volume of 38.52L, the CMP 320 fits compact setups while supporting Mini-ITX and Micro-ATX motherboards. It features versatile cooling options, fitting up to six fans in various radiator sizes, including 280mm on top and 240mm in front. Inside the case, there are 4 expansion slots, 2 combo 2.5"/3.5" drive bays, and 2 dedicated 2.5" drive bays to hold your drives. Its I/O panel includes one USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type A, one USB 2.0 port, and a 3.5mm headset jack (audio + mic) for easy connectivity. The CMP 320 is fitted with up to 16.5mm of cable routing space, and top and bottom dust filters for a cleaner system, and it supports mounting an ATX power supply from the bottom. It also includes an ARGB fan hub for managing the lighting effects in your case. This allows for clearance of up to 163.5mm on the CPU cooler, 160mm on the PSU, and up to 365mm GPU without front fans/radiator, ready for powerful builds. Backed by a 2-year warranty, the Cooler Master CMP 320 should be a reliable choice for gamers who want a functional and stylish case for their systems.
